@echo off
echo Restoring Windows Memory Compression...
PowerShell -NoProfile -Command "Enable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression"
PowerShell -NoProfile -Command "Enable-MMAgent -PageCombining"
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v "DisablePagingExecutive" /f >nul 2>&1
echo Memory Management restored. Restart your PC.
pause
